decision.reason: The current PDFs expose page 76 as raster page images with OCR/text overlays, not native original-layout design objects. The text layer is a source witness but it is corrupt/derivative and does not add fonts, vectors, hidden partial placements, higher-resolution assets, or strict unit/order wording that would unlock extraction.
